name: Prehistoric Survival Title Card
description: A full-title survival explainer cover that connects one simple stick-limbed figure to a concrete environmental challenge.
composition_guidance: Create a clear 16:9 survival title card with one anatomically simple stick-limbed figure facing a concrete survival challenge. Keep the figure and the surrounding evidence — weather, terrain or simple material detail — visibly connected whenever it is relevant. Use a limited earthy or icy palette, a readable mobile-scale silhouette, and an uncluttered right-side or upper title-safe band for an energetic high-contrast full title or full question rendered directly by the selected image model.
composition_rules: Show one anatomically simple stick-limbed figure as the primary emotional anchor.
Connect the figure to one visible survival challenge through relevant weather, terrain or simple material evidence rather than isolated decorative props.
Reserve either a right-side or an upper title-safe band for the complete high-contrast title rendered by the image model.
Keep the silhouette, survival evidence, and title readable in a single fast mobile viewing pass.
required_elements: One anatomically simple stick-limbed ancient human
One concrete survival challenge with materially connected evidence
A limited earthy or icy educational-cartoon palette
A readable full episode-title or full-question card rendered by the image model
avoid_elements: Violence, tissue or wound texture, or threatening combat
Invented armour, magic, fake archaeology, or modern objects
Copied episode titles, channel branding, watermarks, logos, or copied trade dress
Dense labels, incidental sign text, illegible or malformed text
headline_guidance: Render the complete intended full episode title or question directly in the title-safe band. Use one, two, or three balanced lines according to title length while preserving high contrast and small-screen readability. Do not reuse saved episode wording, channel identity, fixed catchphrases, or source-specific signs.
visual_style_guidance: Keep the recipe independent of its active visual style while favoring an original simple 2D educational cartoon: clean black outlines, stick-limbed figures, flat limited colors, simple clothing and tools, connected survival evidence, and no photorealism or invented spectacle.
